Package neqsim.thermo.util.steam

Class LiquidWaterReference

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.util.steam.LiquidWaterReference
public final class LiquidWaterReference extends Object
Reference properties of pure liquid water from the IAPWS formulations.

Thermodynamic properties come from the IAPWS-IF97 Region 1 Gibbs function, evaluated as a liquid at any pressure so that an aqueous phase in a gas mixture is never switched to the steam region. Viscosity uses IAPWS R12-08 and thermal conductivity IAPWS R15-11, both without the critical enhancement term, which is negligible for a dense liquid below 623.15 K. Region 1 is validated for 273.15 to 623.15 K up to 100 MPa; states below 273.15 K or below the saturation pressure are metastable extrapolations of the same equations and are flagged by isMetastable().
